program.about: For arms that look obscene holding her up against the wall or pinning her wrists while you fuck her. Every day is biceps and triceps in supersets, paired with the chest one day and the shoulders the next, then a short AMRAP of push-ups and HIIT for the pump and a sweat. Plenty of reps, moderate weights and short rests. Level II adds reps and Level III asks for heavier dumbbells.
